scripts.preflight:electron: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const exe=process.platform==='win32'?'electron.exe':'electron';if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules/electron/dist/'+exe)){console.error('Electron binary missing from node_modules/electron/dist.
